claims.citation: New York Herald, 3 June 1866, p. 2, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Ship Grahams Polley, Burgess, Glasgow, 35 days, with
mdse, to J Atkins & Co. Had heavy westerly gales east of
the Banks. Crossed the Banks May 19, since had light west-
erly winds and calms with thick fog. April 27, in the North [cut]
Channel, spoke ship City of Montreal, from Glasgow for New
York; May 15, lat 45 03, lon 46 40, passed bark Isabel, of
Swansea, bound W.
